ai_summary: Tata Steel Limited has acquired a 9.99% stake in APL Apollo Tubes Limited, purchasing 2,77,38,075 equity shares at INR 2,100 each through an on-market block deal on November 23, 2026. This significant acquisition, made from a prior zero holding, materially impacts APL Apollo Tubes' ownership structure and suggests a strategic intent from Tata Steel. The context of this deal being "further to" an announced open offer indicates a potential larger takeover bid, signaling an aggressive strategic move by Tata Steel.
